title: Page login is not the identity the gateway evaluated
goal: A person signs in to this page as demouser, while the door's agent key acts as aidemo. {{castBrand}} wants to know which of the two the gateway decides on.
obstacle: Two identities are on the screen and they are not the same. It is easy to assume the gateway judged the person who is signed in.
control: The gateway decides on the identity behind the agent key, not on the page login. The identity rail shows both and labels the mismatch as a SIMULATED scenario. In Real the lab shows only the identity its own settings declare, because a real 401 or 403 names no identity.
say: Two names, one decision, and it belongs to the key's identity. This mismatch is a Mock-only scenario.

steps.title: Run with the mismatch scenario
steps.tell: Choose the identity-mismatch scenario and run list_entitlements. The verdict is Allowed, and the rail shows the page login demouser beside the gateway identity aidemo, with a SIMULATED note.
steps.say: Allowed for aidemo. The page login did not decide anything.
steps.why: A page login proves who is at the screen. The agent key decides who the gateway evaluates.

steps.title: Read the identity label
steps.tell: The label reads Identity the gateway evaluated in Mock. In Real it would read Identity declared by this lab's settings.
steps.say: The label changes with the source because what the lab knows changes.
steps.why: Real never says the gateway checked an identity, because it cannot see one.
